# Himanshu Rawat

> AI product builder and BBA student at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. Builds and ships small AI products with TypeScript, React and Python. Winner of the Trackshift Paytm Hackathon.

## Projects

- [pillybot](https://www.pillybot.app): dementia medication companion, 200+ families in early access
- [aimpact](https://aimpact.himanshufr.me/): a board of small nonprofit tasks that people or their AI agents can volunteer for, with human review
- [slipstream](https://goodmaxgram.vercel.app/): F1 team-radio triage for the pit wall, Trackshift Paytm Hackathon winner
- [focusflow](https://flow.himanshufr.me/): ADHD-friendly productivity workbench
- [Yuno](https://yuno.himanshufr.me/): web studio building English and Chinese websites for exporters
